## Your match

- Solo vs AI (Easy/Normal), AI room, or online 1v1 with a friend?
- How did it end — victory, defeat, or did you stop early? Why?

## What was fun / felt right

<!-- Moments that worked. If you know Age of Empires II, tell us where
     Skirmish II felt like home. -->

## What broke, confused, or annoyed you

<!-- Anything: a button you hunted for, a number that felt off, a moment
     the game did not answer your input the way you expected. -->

## If you could change ONE thing

<!-- One thing only — it forces the honest answer. Note: the mechanics
     themselves are finished like chess and are not up for redesign;
     but how the game *feels*, *shows*, and *explains* things is exactly
     what we want to hear about. If your one thing is "in DE it works
     differently", even better — please file it as a Fidelity report so
     it gets the fast lane. -->

## Anything else

<!-- Device/browser, how you found the game, whether you'd send the
     link to a friend. -->
